usage: The word '搜尋' is mainly used as a noun to refer to the act of searching or the search process.
'搜尋' can be used when talking about searching on the internet or searching for information.
It often appears in contexts related to technology, especially web browsing.
You can say '網上搜尋' to specify searching online.
It is commonly paired with verbs like '做' (do) or '進行' (carry out) when describing the action of searching.
